CU Boulder students · 2026

Show up.
Get counted.

Election Day is Tuesday, Nov. 3. Register or check your status at Vote.org, then make a plan to vote.

Register or check at Vote.org ↗

You can register and vote in person through Election Day. Bring valid ID; your Buff OneCard is accepted. Official hours and voter information ↗. Boulder Culture is nonpartisan.

UMC Vote Center

1669 Euclid Ave.
Open Oct. 26–Nov. 3
Weekdays, 8 a.m.–6 p.m. · Sat., Oct. 31, 8 a.m.–5 p.m.
Election Day, 7 a.m.–7 p.m.

Williams Village

500 30th St.
Open Nov. 2–3
Mon., Nov. 2, 8 a.m.–6 p.m. · Election Day, 7 a.m.–7 p.m.

Have a ballot to drop off?

24-hour ballot drop boxes are at UMC and Williams Village. Drop your ballot by 7 p.m. on Nov. 3.
